source_data_license: No explicit data licence identified; do not redistribute the workbooks.
selected_spectra: Source SI spectra 2–15 (Python indices 2 through 15; 0.75–5 L); exact workbook files and SHA-256 values are in results.json.

preprocessing.source_baseline: Subtract mean signal for 400 < T < 500 K.
preprocessing.temperature_conversion: Input workbook is in K; subtract 273.15 for the fitter's Celsius input. No measured-time series is constructed.

models: Free-order single-state fit over the production fitter bounds.

optimizer.fitted_parameters: Energy, prefactor and signal scale; free-order case also optimizes order.

comparison: Compare whole-window fits descriptively with same-source leading-edge estimates in the source SI; different estimands and not independent validation truth.
limits: Source reports coverage-dependent barrier; constant-energy model is intentionally restricted.
Signal scale is free and normalized initial coverage is one in the production fitter; dose is not treated as measured coverage.
Fit statistics are conditional on this model, selected intervals and source processing.
